title: Batten Down the Rings
author: Ambrose
rules:
Rules

Ring-ring: Draw rectangular loops through the centers of empty cells so that every empty cell gets used. The sides of different rectangles may intersect each other, but not turn at their intersection or otherwise overlap.

Battenburg: Each empty cell has one of three types of path in it (irrespective of rotation): Straight, Corner, or Cross. A checkerboard symbol at a vertex means that the 4 empty cells touching it have exactly two types, one type on one diagonal pair and a second type on the other diagonal pair. Every vertex satisfying this condition is marked by a checkerboard symbol.
